description: Clear an input/textarea and fill it with new text. Pass ref from browser_snapshot (preferred) or a selector. For contenteditable editors prefer browser_type.

nthMatch.description: If the selector matches multiple elements, fill the Nth (0-indexed).

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector — exact match, no guessing.

selector.description: Playwright selector for the input/textarea to fill (CSS, text="...", :has-text("..."), role=..., [data-testid="..."]). Fallback when you have no ref. NEVER use :contains().

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

textHint.description: Auto-heal: if the selector matches 0 elements, server retries with role=*[name~="<textHint>"].

value.description: The text value to fill. Clears existing content first.

name: browser_fill
